resources.string: The connection is incomplete or expired. Exchange an updated invitation with this contact.

For internet delivery, activate the pilot in both profiles before creating invitations. Exchange the invitation and responses, compare the verification code and confirm the connection. Delivery settings are exchanged automatically; medical access is selected separately.

Send this package and allow future changes to the selected fields for this recipient. New fields stay private. The recipient approves updates once in the chat. You can stop updates in the contact details.
Allow this verified author to send updates to this selection. Received records remain separate from your own diary.
No connection. Delivery will retry when the network returns.
Server limit reached. Retry will respect the server’s waiting period.
The server denied access. Check pilot activation and the connection.
Delivery could not continue. Check the connection and retry.
